leadIn.title: Lead-In & Context: Present Continuous
leadIn.content: Actions happening right now: Look! It is raining outside, and Marco is drinking tea by the window.

instructionCheck.question: Do you describe actions happening right now or what people did yesterday?

meaningCheck.question: "He is cooking dinner." — Is he cooking right now in this current moment?
options: No, he cooks dinner every Sunday
Yes, the action is happening right now in progress
No, he finished cooking an hour ago
meaningCheck.explanation: Correct · Present continuous describes actions happening right now at the time of speaking.

meaningCheck.question: "They are staying at a hotel this week." — Is this a permanent home or a temporary situation?
options: A temporary situation for a short period
A past trip from last year
meaningCheck.explanation: Correct · Present continuous expresses temporary situations around the present time.

form.title: Form & Structure: Present Continuous
form.content: Subject + am/is/are + verb-ing. Negative: am/is/are + not + verb-ing. Question: Am/Is/Are + subject + verb-ing?

pronunciation.title: Pronunciation Notes: Present Continuous
pronunciation.content: Spoken stress, weak forms, intonation, and articulation patterns for Present Continuous.

controlledPractice.question: 'She ___ dinner right now.'
controlledPractice.explanation: An action happening now needs am/is/are + -ing.

controlledPractice.question: Spelling: run + -ing?
controlledPractice.explanation: One vowel + one final consonant → double the consonant: run → running.

controlledPractice.question: Fix: 'He working now.'
controlledPractice.explanation: Present continuous always needs am/is/are before the -ing verb.
